findings.cci_color_records: all 39 *_hef_skull CCI records carry byte-identical color data (InstanceColors, ColorIndicies, IndexColors, Index0Colors, pattern defaults) — one generic item record set, fitted per character
findings.ci_character_field: each CI names its character via Character = CharacterItemEditor::ID_<ABBR>; CommonGroup is 'cmn_hef' for 35 characters and 'unique' for EDD, LEE, LEI, MIG; InstanceName 'SK_CH_cmn_hef_skull' is present on 34 CI records and absent (default) on EDD, ELZ, LEE, LEI, MIG; several CIs also carry a CaptureBankID integer property (per-file values in props, not interpreted here)
findings.suit_variant: CCI_dra_hef_skull_suit / CI_dra_hef_skull_suit are a separate item (LocationName MI_CH_dra_hef_skull_suit_mask) with its own defaults (InstanceColors [0.576456,0.622775,0.635,1], [0.0775,0.133997,0.155,1], white, white; ColorIndicies [ColorIndex num1, ColorIndex num2, ColorIndex_Private, ColorIndex_Private]) — NOT merged into the skull-mask entry
